## Purpose and linked work

Backlog/ADR reference:

## Change classification

- [ ] CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE update with sanitized evidence
- [ ] PROPOSED TARGET STATE change
- [ ] OPEN DECISION or review outcome

## Design impact

Describe dependencies, trust boundaries, alternatives and relevant rollback/verification expectations.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Status is accurate; proposals are not presented as deployed facts.
- [ ] PROJECT/backlog/architecture links are consistent.
- [ ] No real environment data appears in files, metadata, history or attachments.
- [ ] No private inventory, state/plans, exports, secrets or raw logs are included.
- [ ] Current architecture-only gate is respected; no infrastructure/automation implementation added.
- [ ] Verification performed is distinguished from future checks.

## Verification and unresolved questions

Record actual document checks and remaining blockers. Do not include raw private evidence.
